notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Patch 2 - A Fistful Of Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Today we're coming at you with another batch of fixes for Alpha 1.5. Please let us know if we missed anything!

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 v1.1.1.5 - Full list of changes


 Added statistics on the time spent to complete the alpha
 Improved optimization
 Added some animations for the Guest
 Graphics settings have been expanded (material quality setting)
 The volume of the combination lock is increased
 Fixed bugs related to AI getting stuck in the house
 Fixed the Guest’s reaction to the kettle
 Fixed a bug where a candy in hand was considered to be placed inside the basket
 Fixed a bug where a player would lose control after the Guest had caught them in a hiding spot


Have fun!

-Imbir🐾, Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Patch 1 - A Ton of Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello ghosts and ghouls!

Thank you all for playing Alpha 1.5 in these last couple of days! We really appreciate your feedback, keep it coming! Not only it helps us to catch all the bugs much quicker, but also to determine where to nudge the game gameplay-wise. 

You may have noticed an in-game survey that pops up after you've played for a bit - this is one of the new ways of listening to your thoughts on the game. Let us know what you think about the new Guest behavior and the new puzzles so that we could make the next Alphas even more fun!

And now, to the update itself. The team has been working tirelessly to eliminate the peskiest of bugs and improve the overall quality of life for Alpha 1.5, and the first patch is now out! There's a lot of fixes. Like, a lot. Take a look for yourself:

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 v1.1.1.4 - Full list of changes


 Backyard house roof got updated geometry for easier jumps
 Updated decorations inside the house and in the open world
 Stationary phone has been moved to the bedroom
 Crowbar puzzle is now more intuitive
 Optimized lighting, other optimizations
 The Guest can now disassemble the generator if it's in their way
 Polished the final cutscene (added sound)
 Optimized sound levels (balancing)
 The Guest can no longer spot a player through the main door
 Improved one of the puzzles for obtaining a candy with the generator
 Lost candies are now more visible in the basket
 The cable now rolls up correctly while attached to the generator
 Decreased the probability of the camera shifting after being caught by the Guest
 The Guest now knocks down an installed CCTV camera instead of being blocked by it
 You can't block doors with the CCTV camera anymore
 Bottles' fullness is now correctly displayed in the inventory
 Fixed player's detection in hiding spots
 Fixed a bug where the Guest would freeze after a key has been taken out of the furnace
 The Guest no longer T-poses :(
 Fixed the bug related to the Guest opening the coded door
 Improved the Guest's behavior on neutral grounds
 The Guest no longer attacks a player while they're in the van
 Fixed incorrect Guest indication on the CCTV display
 Fixed incorrect display of candies when thrown into the basket 


Let us know in the comments what are the important issues that remain unfixed!

-Imbir🐾, Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Patch 6 - Imbir says "Hi"!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

My name is Imbir, and I'll be taking over the Steam posts for now.

Here are the patch notes the developers gave me. I'd comment on them, but I'm a cat, so I can't read. Enjoy:

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1 Update - Version 1.0.4.0

 The drone is back in the game
 Fixed and improved AI behavior
 You can now knock the Guest down using a rope. The rope has to be tied on one end with the other hand in the player's hands.
 Added new behavior and animations for Imbir (the cat)
 Controls prompt in the menu now switch depending on your input (keyboard and mouse/controller)
 Fixed switching between items in the inventory when using a controller
 Fixed the wooden planks getting stuck while being torn off
 Fixed the ability to burn items in the fireplace while holding them in hands
 Fixed the ability to leave a hiding spot while using a display
 Fixed the second-floor window, you can now jump through it
 Fixed a bug that would cause players to get stuck inside the house (collisions of the floor and the walls) after being caught by the Guest
 The canister now explodes when thrown into the fireplace
 Fixed crashes that occurred when using a rope


If you didn't get the update automatically, please restart your Steam client. 

Catch you later!
&
Mew!

- 
Eerie Guest & Imbir & tinyBuild

notes.title: Patch 5 - Less Crashes & Some Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Thank you for all your feedback, keep it coming! For this next patch, we've fixed one of the major issues that was causing the game to crash, as well as added some new interactions and animations.

Here are the full patch notes: 

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1 Update - Version 1.0.3.0

 Bottles can now be destroyed by throwing them into the fireplace. This will cause the fire to go out.
 Boxes can now be burnt down
 Fixed an issue where the Guest would attack the player while the player is on the neutral territory and has no items
 Added new animations for holding various items
 Fixed the Guest's animations while he's crouching
 Fixed the Guest's sounds playback in the game's finale
 Fixed the positioning of the player upon exiting the car
 Fixed crashes caused by throwing items out of the player's inventory

Known bugs:

 Wooden planks on the attic door might get stuck
 The Guest might get stuck in the crowbar room



If you didn't get the update automatically, please restart your Steam client. 

Catch you later!

- 
Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Patch 4 - some small additions and more bug fixes!

 Added gamma correction at the start of the game
 Improved map visuals
 Improved visuals and mechanics of hiding behind the curtain
 Added sounds to the final cutscene
 Added particles for throwing boxes
 Improved visual effects and sounds for tearing off wooden planks

 AI Behavior improvements

 Improved crowbar control animation
 Code door can no longer be opened by throwing heavy objects at it

 Fixed a bug where players would get stuck in display control after falling from a height
 Fixed the key position in the fireplace

notes.title: Patch 3 - More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey there! 

The battle against the bugs is still going, but we will prevail in the end. Thank you so much for all your feedback, we read every message obsessively, and we're super grateful for your support!

Without further ado, here's the whole list of changes:

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1 Update - Version 1.0.1.0

 Corrected AI behavior
 Fixed navigation issues for narrow passages
 Fixed an issue where a player would lose control after falling from a height while using binoculars
 Fixed an issue where loading while in the final stage of the alpha would cause characters to double, resulting in a crash
 The fireplace now correctly detects items thrown into it
 Corrected visual effects for the fire and smoke produced by the fireplace
 Fixed plank scaling while prying it off with a crowbar
 The Guest now stumbles much less frequently on the items he picks up
 The Guest is now easier to knock down by throwing an item at him
 Door code now changes for each new game
 Fixed the start of the Guest's fire extinguisher flight animation
 Fixed collisions for various objects
 Fixed invisible collision in the doorway leading to the backyard



If you didn't get the update automatically, please restart your Steam client. 

Catch you later!

- 
Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Thank you so much for all of your support and feedback on the Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1. Since it is an alpha, some pesky bugs are bound to crop up, and we're determined to patch them as quickly as possible. Here's the first batch:

Day 1 Patch Notes

 Fixed the opening cutscene error
 Tweaked and added some items to the map
 Adjusted some collisions for the better player and AI navigation
 Removed kitchen curtain that had been causing the game to soft-lock
 "Lost" items remain "lost" after loading a save: if you dropped an item, it will be brought back to the Guest's house by crows after you load your game
 Slightly improved the performance by way of partial light baking
 Crows now take into account thrown items after a player has loaded a save



If you didn't get the update automatically, please restart your Steam client. 

Catch you later!

- 
Eerie Guest & tinyBuild
